- Name: CWI Agent Memory (slug: cwi-agent-memory-system)
- Version: 1.0.0 | Lineage: R3 | Stage: packaged

## What it is

Durable AES-256 agent memory with GitHub-backed pool and L1 off-chain chain anchors (EIP-712, no gas).

## Intended use

CWI agents / any agent needing durable memory.

## Capabilities

- memory.js read/write CLI
- salted SHA-256 chain anchors
- chain-verify over the live fleet

## Honest limitations

Private repo (CumulativeWebInc/cwi-agent-memory); encryption untouched; conversion leg not run.
